International students
SMU is a top-tier liberal arts and R1 research university where more than 12,500 students from all 50 states and 90+ countries learn, connect and thrive. Our globally diverse community offers a welcoming environment, while SMU’s R1 status provides exceptional access to research opportunities. With small class sizes, personalized learning and dedicated faculty support, students are empowered to achieve their goals. Join the Mustang Charge and discover what’s possible at SMU.

Who is an international student?
At SMU, an international student is any student who is required to have a visa to live and study in the United States, including non-immigrant visas such as L2, H2 or E2 visas. Your SMU admission process and SMU admission counselor are determined by your current high school or university.
Please note: Students with DACA, or other undocumented status, are not considered international students, and will follow the standard admission process.
U.S. citizens attending high school or university outside the U.S. should follow the international admission process.
International students attending high school or university in the U.S. should follow the standard admission process.

We invest in the best and the brightest
All students who apply to SMU, regardless of citizenship, are automatically considered for SMU’s generous academic merit scholarships.* There is no separate application process. Most scholarships are stackable and may be combined, but cannot exceed the cost of tuition and fees. Don’t lose out. Apply to SMU today. smu.edu/apply
*Need-based financial aid is available only for U.S. citizens or permanent U.S. residents.
